note: DishonoredLoadAllPackages (Engine/Src/DishonoredLoadAll.cpp, agent AD's file, additive edit by AX): -loadallpurge collects with RF_Native|RF_Marked instead of RF_Native|RF_Marked|RF_Standalone so the swept package's assets are reclaimed (without it the 32-bit address space is gone after a few dozen packages); a LoadPackage that returns NULL is counted and the sweep continues (only a linker abort shuts the object system down); the load line is logged before the collect and a second line, loadall purged <pkg>: <N> objects live, after it, so a package whose teardown crashes still has its load result. No retail counterpart (bring-up switch).

resources/tools/debug/loadall_sweep.py (new): the milestone 3 exit check. upk drives -loadall over every .upk under the retail cooked directories through build_and_smoke.py and restarts at the next package after a crash; pck parses every Wwise AKPK file package header (a .pck is not a UE3 package and LoadPackage can never read one) and bounds-checks every lookup-table entry; report merges both into resources/docs/loadall_baseline.{csv,md}.

resources/tools/run_regression.py (new): one command that builds and re-measures every number the waves earned - CoreSmoke, LayoutProbe + xcheck_sdk_layout + gen_layout_probe compare + verify_phase2 retail, the null-RHI milestone run, the d3d9 render run with frame and scene-census counts, the -inputtest walked distance, the PhysX scene counts and the unported-native count on the path. Expectations live in resources/docs/regression_baseline.json (op/value/optional/note per metric), so tightening a bound or adding a counter is a data change. Exits non-zero on any regression.

UMaterial::FinishDestroy (Engine/Src/Material.cpp:1925) deletes DefaultMaterialInstances[0..2] but the array is FDefaultMaterialInstance*[2] (retail/2012 PDB layout, EngineMaterialClasses.h:3949), so index 2 aliases the next member, INT EditorX, and `delete (FDefaultMaterialInstance*)EditorX` faults. 29 of the 471 cooked packages crash in the garbage-collect purge because of it (EBP chain UMaterial::FinishDestroy+0x56 <- IncrementalPurgeGarbage <- CollectGarbage, read at 0xfffffcfd = EditorX -771). Fix: loop to ARRAY_COUNT(DefaultMaterialInstances) as UMaterial::UMaterial already does for MaterialResources. Not AX's file - coordinator or the renderer package.
